liebermann.notes: After Henry of Huntingdon, the Tripartita with Rubricator II (Wl art, like Vi changing the title to plural majesty; cf. rv), the rubric list to ECf, ECf retr and the Genealogia Normannica to 1154; English history continued as in Gr to 1232, and finally the same verses as in Lb.

entries.text_de:
British Museum Regius 13 A XVIII4, um 1350, hinter Huntingdon f. 109 Tripartita mit Rubricator II, d. i. Wl art, u. S. 486, ebenso wie Vi den Titel in Plur. maj. wandelnd; vgl. rv. F. 109b Rubrikenliste zu ECf, u. S. 670; f. 110 ECf retr, u. S. 627; f. 116 Geneal. Normannica bis 1154. Die Engl. Geschichte wird wie in Gr bis 1232 fortgesetzt.

Zuletzt dieselben Verse wie in Lb, o. S. xxxiii.
entries.text_en:
British Museum Regius 13 A XVIII4, c. 1350, after Huntingdon f. 109 Tripartita with Rubricator II, i.e. Wl art, below, p. 486, changing the title into the plural of majesty, just as Vi does; cf. rv. F. 109b list of rubrics to ECf, below, p. 670; f. 110 ECf retr, below, p. 627; f. 116 Geneal. Normannica to 1154. The English history is continued, as in Gr, to 1232.

Finally the same verses as in Lb, above, p. xxxiii.

notes.text_de: vgl. mein Über Leges Ed. Conf. S. 130; Suchier in Zeitschr. f. Roman. Phil. XXI S. 225.
notes.text_en: cf. my Über Leges Ed. Conf. p. 130; Suchier in Zeitschr. f. Roman. Phil. XXI p. 225.

transcription.doubts: Entry runs from the foot of col. 1 to the top of col. 2. 'Wl art' is followed by a comma (a speck makes it look like a period). xxxiii is in small capitals.
